title: Hook-fed logging: every tool call and CLI event leaves a structured trace
subject: hook-fed-logging
ratio: Observability is hook-fed and mandatory. In sessions rooted in this repo, the PostToolUse hook appends every tool call to transcript.jsonl; events.jsonl, written by the CLIs themselves, is the engine-agnostic floor that holds for every engine and session shape. No agent may bypass, disable, or rescope the logging channel, and an unobservable trajectory is a harness defect to report, not a private convenience.
dicta: Tier 2 on P-003, the gen-1 accepted_mutations entry (bundled through the human-gated T-007 apply) that scoped the hook to repo-rooted sessions and made the pillar real; T-011 is the hook liveness smoke. The P-003 hook-scoping census item is subsumed by this record (CD8). Distinct from the observability-integrity record published later in this wave: this record mandates the channel, that one mandates completeness and integrity of what flows through it. Frozen by the codification ledger row decision:T-377#cd-08.
scope_conditions: role:any agent operating in a session rooted in this repo
role:thinker running evolution audits over the logs
revisit_trigger: Revisit if the PostToolUse hook is removed or rescoped, or events.jsonl stops being the CLI-written floor.
validity_conditions: transcript.jsonl grows by at least one line per tool call in sessions rooted in this repo
